sources.description: Exact category labels attached to the saved live-board rows.
sources.limitations: Current-board coverage only; categories may later be recategorized.

sources.description: Kalshi event envelopes; event_json must be decoded with tools.snapshot.payload_text because rows may be zlib-compressed BLOBs.
sources.limitations: The historical pass selects one saved event envelope per market_id with SQL GROUP BY. It can miss category revisions for the same event; the latest-board pass and conflict exclusion reduce but do not eliminate this limitation. The frozen replay corpus expires in 2026, so the limitation is bounded to that corpus.

sources.description: Exact series/category metadata preserved by calibration_harvest records.
sources.limitations: Sparse historical supplement; only explicit category is used. Derived domain labels are excluded.

policy: Only exact observed category labels are retained. A series observed with more than one category is excluded from categories and recorded in conflicts; no ticker/title inference is used.
